design: Three matched scenario pairs, one fresh session per arm. Same fixture source per pair; treatment may use baseline:inspect, control may not. No model override.

scenarios.static: Reduce only the services grid gap by 25 percent, preserving global tokens and other grids.
scenarios.sveltia: Add optional integer readingMinutes (1..60) to typed posts and paired editor form; render conditionally on article detail. Preserve legacy content and verify boundaries.
scenarios.cms: Use MCP to create an owned draft post with exact supplied text; keep it unpublished and report the publishing permission boundary.

metrics: Actual wrapper-recorded discovery requests and output bytes; includes repeat requests
Verified source preservation and requested constraints
limits: Exploratory N=1 pair per scenario; no statistical performance, token-cost or elapsed-time claim.
Project source/artifacts are separated, but dependencies/cache are explicitly shared through junctions. No strict process/filesystem sandbox is claimed.
Tool wrapper is an instructed telemetry convention, not an enforced tool-runner boundary.
CMS trials share a synthetic server, separate scoped contributor identities and unique slugs; namespace separation is not independent database isolation.
No GitHub editor login/save, hosted OAuth, D1 or production acceptance.
